measurement_scope: Mixed: Invoke operations use --waitForEvent (full endorsement+ordering+commit path); Query operations measure peer evaluation only. Both include Docker exec IPC overhead (~2-5ms on WSL2/Windows).

implementation_notes.query_finalized_state: GetOrder(orderID): single GetState CouchDB lookup returning committed order JSON.
implementation_notes.submit_result: SubmitMatchingResult with empty matchedPairs + 2 valid base64 signatures. Idempotency key unique per run. Chaincode: idempotency check + threshold sig check + computation verify (trivial for empty pairs) + state write.
implementation_notes.submit_task: CreateBuyOrder: validates user exists (consumer type), writes new order UUID to ledger. Maps to SubmitTask. Does not include HMAC preprocessing proof in this benchmark (uses basic CreateBuyOrder).
implementation_notes.verify_committee_signatures: VerifyCommitteeSignatures: measures signature-format checking and threshold-count checking rather than full cryptographic ECDSA verification. Chaincode checks base64 decodability and count >= threshold only.
implementation_notes.verify_membership: VerifyMembershipProof(userID, layerID, witnessA, accumulatorStr): loads RSA accumulator state from CouchDB, deserializes 1024-bit N and A, computes H(userID), evaluates witness^H(userID) mod N (real 1024-bit RSA modular exponentiation). witnessA = accumulator A value; verification returns false (invalid witness) but compute cost is identical to valid verification. Prototype limitation: AccumulatorState does not persist per-user witnesses or member list; valid witnesses cannot be retrieved after the block commit transaction completes.

results.implementation_note: Calls VerifyMembershipProof(userID, layerID, witnessA, accumulatorStr). Chaincode loads RSA accumulator state from CouchDB, deserializes 1024-bit N and A, computes H(userID) = hash_to_group(userID), then evaluates witness^H(userID) mod N (real RSA 1024-bit modular exponentiation) and compares with A. witnessA is set to the current A value to trigger a full-size RSA exp; verification returns false (invalid witness) but the compute cost is identical to a successful verification. Prototype limitation: AccumulatorState does not persist per-user witnesses; a valid witness requires RSA secrets (p,q) or per-transaction computation which is discarded after block commit.
